sqlMap.update: UPDATE SY_USER SY SET SY.PASSWORD=#NEW_PS#, SY.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, SY.UPDATED_BY = #PERSON_ID# WHERE SY.PERSON_ID=#PERSON_ID# AND #PERSON_ID# IS NOT NULL
sqlMap.select:
SELECT
HI.PERSON_ID, GET_GLOBAL_NAME( HI.FINAL_DEGREE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FINAL_DEGREE_CODE ,
HE.CPNY_ID, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HI.NATIONALITY_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HI.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,
GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HI.REG_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) REG_TYPE_CODE, HI.REG_PLACE,
HD.ORG_NAME_LOCAL, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, HE.LOCAL_NAME, substr(HE.PROMOTION_DAY,0,7) PROMOTION_DAY, HE.EMPID, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE_NO, SY.PASSWORD, SY.USER_NAME
FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HI,HR_DEPARTMENT HD,HR_EMPLOYEE HE,SY_USER SY WHERE HI.PERSON_ID=#PERSON_ID_ID# AND HD.DEPTNO=HE.DEPTNO AND HE.PERSON_ID=SY.PERSON_ID AND HI.PERSON_ID=HE.PERSON_ID AND HI.ACTIVITY=1
